A

A. LISTENING (2.0 POINTS)

Nghe đoạn hội thoại chỉ đường và trả lời các câu hỏi

I. Listen and choose the correct answer (Questions 1–5)

1. What is the girl planning to do?

2. Which place does she visit first?

3. What does she do after crossing the street?

4. Where will she finally arrive?

5. What directions does the boy give her?

II. Listen and tick True (T) or False (F) (Questions 6–10)

6. She is creating an audio guide for her neighbourhood.

7. The streets are quiet and peaceful.

8. She visits the museum first.

9. She likes noisy streets.

10. The boy tells her how to reach the pagoda.

B

B. VOCABULARY & GRAMMAR (3.0 POINTS)

Từ vựng, Ngữ pháp, Tìm lỗi sai và Dạng của động từ

I. Multiple choice (Questions 11–20)

11. What is “bưu điện” in English?

12. How do you say “rẽ ngõ thứ hai bên trái”?

13. I ______ noisy streets in my neighbourhood.

14. Streets are ______ than alleys.

15. Life in the countryside is ______ than in the city.

16. I dislike streets ______ they are crowded.

17. There are many shops in my district. → My district ______ many shops.

18. What do you like ______ your neighbourhood?

19. Shall we ______ to the cinema first?

20. Let’s ______ to the museum next.

II. Find the Error (Questions 21–22)

21. She like going to the museum every weekend.

22. First go along this street, then turns right.

III. Verb forms (Questions 23–25)

23. I (follow) the audio guide carefully.

24. He (ask) for directions to the museum.

25. They (fill) in the blanks on the worksheet.

C

C. READING COMPREHENSION (2.4 POINTS)

Đọc hiểu đoạn văn và chọn đáp án phù hợp

I. Picture observation (Question 26)

26. The picture shows students following directions in a district. What are they doing?

II. Cloze passage (Questions 27–31)

Our neighbourhood has many interesting places. There is a cinema, a post office, a museum, a pagoda, and several workshops. To visit the museum, first, go along the street, then (27) ______ right. After that, cross the street and take the second turning on the left. The streets are (28) ______ than those in the city centre. I like visiting the museum because it is (29) ______. Life in the district is (30) ______ than in the neighbouring district. There are many things to do, and it’s very (31) ______.

27. Select word for blank (27):

28. Select word for blank (28):

29. Select word for blank (29):

30. Select word for blank (30):

31. Select word for blank (31):

III. Reading passage (Questions 32–37)

Students in my neighbourhood like going to the cinema and museum. Some go to the workshops to make crafts. Streets are busy but beautiful. Some streets are noisy, but overall it is peaceful. My favourite place is the museum because it is exciting. I also like the pagoda. I often ask for directions and follow an audio guide when exploring.

32. What is the best title?

33. Which places are in the neighbourhood?

34. Which is the favourite place of the author?

35. How are the streets described in the passage?

36. Which place is NOT mentioned in the text?

37. How does she feel about her favourite place?

D

D. SHORT WRITING (2.6 POINTS)

Tự gõ câu hoàn chỉnh vào ô bên dưới (Không chọn trắc nghiệm)

I. Rearrange the words to make complete sentences (Questions 38–40)

38. / go / Shall / we / the museum / to / ? /

→

39. / cross / First / street / the / turn / , / right / then /

→

40. / to / Let’s / the cinema / go /

→

II. Rewrite the sentences without changing their meaning (Questions 41–45)

41. I like the cinema because it is exciting.

→ I like the cinema it is exciting.

42. The streets are noisy.

→ I dislike the streets they are noisy.

43. Life in my neighbourhood is more peaceful than in the city centre.

→ The city centre is my neighbourhood.

44. Shall we go to the museum?

→ we go to the museum?

45. Let’s go to the cinema first.

→ go to the cinema first.

MINI REVIEW - ÔN TẬP NHANH UNIT 4

Ghi nhớ trọng tâm kiến thức bài học

Từ Vựng Cần Nhớ (Key Vocabulary)

  • post office: bưu điện
  • museum: bảo tàng
  • pagoda: chùa
  • take the first/second turning on the left: rẽ ở ngõ thứ nhất/hai bên trái

Cấu Trúc Ngữ Pháp (Core Structures)

  • So sánh hơn tính từ ngắn: S + be + adj-er + than... (quieter, wider)
  • So sánh hơn tính từ dài: S + be + more + adj + than... (more peaceful)
  • Lời gợi ý: Shall we + V-bare...? / Let's + V-bare... / Why don't we + V-bare...?
  • Chỉ nguyên nhân: Clause + because + S + V...
